g.text: Five interleaved warm repetitions per block; lower RSS is better.

text.style: font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Bars: medians. Whiskers: min–max. Accepted blocks only; zero audited model-inference overlaps.
